key.summary: Equalizer options (equalizer might not be supported by your headset)

key.summary: Parametric equalizer options (parametric equalizer might not be supported by your headset)

key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the microphone mute LED brightness

key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the microphone volume

key.name: option-anc
key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the noise cancelling mode

key.summary: Parameter to set noise cancelling at power on
key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the noise cancelling mode at power on

key.summary: Parameter to set the noise cancelling button modes
key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the modes the noise cancelling button cycles through

key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the headset volume

key.description: Last value set with the headset volume slider or reported by the headset (0-128, -1 unknown)

key.name: option-bt-call-volume
key.summary: Parameter to set Bluetooth call volume
key.description: Passed to headsetcontrol to set the Bluetooth call volume

key.name: bt-call-volume-value
key.description: Last value set with the Bluetooth call volume slider (0-100, -1 unknown), as the headset cannot report it

key.name: notification-low-battery
key.summary: Parameter to enable notification when battery is low
key.description: Send a notification when the battery level is low

key.name: use-logging
key.description: Enable / disable log outputs

key.name: show-systemindicator
key.description: Makes the systemindicator show/hide

key.name: hidewhendisconnected-systemindicator
key.summary: Hide the systemindicator when no headset is connected
key.description: Will be delayed by refresh interval - can be enforced by toggling the quicksettings

key.name: refreshinterval-systemindicator
key.summary: Refresh the systemindicator every X minutes
key.description: Value in minutes to refresh the headset data on the systemindicator

key.name: use-colors
key.summary: Parameter to enable battery percentage text color
key.description: Makes battery percentage text colored/non-colored

key.name: color-batteryhigh
key.description: The text color for battery charge 100% to 51%

key.name: color-batterymedium
key.description: The text color for battery charge 50% to 26%

key.name: color-batterylow
key.description: The text color for battery charge 25% to 0%

key.name: sidetone-values
key.description: Used for sidetone values off, low, medium, high, max (-1 disable)

key.name: quicksettings-toggle
key.description: Enum - 0 Systemindicator, 1 Notifications, 2 Logs, 3 Colors

key.name: inactivetime-values
key.description: Used for inactive time values (-1 disable)

key.name: low-battery-threshold
key.summary: Battery percentage to trigger low battery notification
key.description: When battery percentage falls below this value, a low battery notification will be triggered

key.name: test-mode
key.description: Enable different test modes, resets on restart
